# Kenco Group

Kenco Group is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Kenco Group is a company that provides integrated logistics solutions, including ecommerce fulfillment, parcel management and shipping solutions, transportation solutions, and contract carriage. Kenco Group employs 3,410 people (+10.7% YoY, +329 people) and has an annual revenue of $1B, founded in 1950. Headquartered in Chattanooga, Tennessee, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 9 countries (including United States, Canada, India, Georgia, and Colombia).

## About

Kenco is a leading North American 3PL delivering custom, integrated logistics solutions that maximize supply chain efficiency. For more than 75 years, they have partnered with customers to provide distribution, transportation, material handling and automation solutions. Kenco’s people set the organization apart—experienced, committed associates who bring agility and expertise to even the most complex supply chain challenges. Guided by its mission and vision, Kenco innovates relentlessly to deliver solutions on a national scale with the care of a local provider, building trusted partnerships that keep goods moving and businesses growing.

# Kenco Corporation

Kenco Corporation is a Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction company. Kenco is a company that offers a wide selection of lifting attachments and excavator attachments. They provide a wide selection of below the hook lifting devices and excavator attachments on the market. Customers can select lifting attachments or request custom quotes. Kenco Corporation employs 35 people (+6.1% YoY, +2 people) and has an annual revenue of $17.5M, founded in 1984. Headquartered in Ligonier, Pennsylvania, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Ghana, and Japan.

## About

Providing productive, profitable attachment solutions through advanced design and construction. 

Kenco has been field-proven time and again by our customers through increased productivity, profitss and worker safety with our excavator attachments. We are the original founder of patented technologies including the Barrier Lift, Pipe Lift, Multilift, Graboid (Rock Lift) and more. 

Our products are based on a unique market of heavy lifting of precast structures such as block, retaining wall, concrete pipe, steel or metal pipe, jersey barrier wall among others. 

Many of our designs have been based on a need in the construction industry that was not being met. Other designs come from custom engineering requests where expertise in the field and certified design is required. 

All products are certified and safely load tested by our engineering team before leaving our facility. 

Since 1984, Kenco has been the worldwide leader in heavy equipment lifting attachments and will continue to be at the forefront of new technologies to improve the safety, speed and productivity in the heavy roadway and construction industries.

properties.description:
Providing productive, profitable attachment solutions through advanced design and construction. 

Kenco has been field-proven time and again by our customers through increased productivity, profitss and worker safety with our excavator attachments. We are the original founder of patented technologies including the Barrier Lift, Pipe Lift, Multilift, Graboid (Rock Lift) and more. 

Our products are based on a unique market of heavy lifting of precast structures such as block, retaining wall, concrete pipe, steel or metal pipe, jersey barrier wall among others. 

Many of our designs have been based on a need in the construction industry that was not being met. Other designs come from custom engineering requests where expertise in the field and certified design is required. 

All products are certified and safely load tested by our engineering team before leaving our facility. 

Since 1984, Kenco has been the worldwide leader in heavy equipment lifting attachments and will continue to be at the forefront of new technologies to improve the safety, speed and productivity in the heavy roadway and construction industries.
